note:
DOWN ONE AND RE-STAMPED AT 476d5f647, AND THE COMPOSITION IS RE-DERIVED RATHER THAN CARRIED. The previous note claimed 78 of the 80 were lane blindness; measured on the rebased tree that is now 79 of 79, and the arithmetic is: 'py_unresolved_calls.py --roots agromarin' reads 79, and the same scan with enterprise beside it reads 3, all three of those in enterprise files. So NO call in any agromarin file is unresolved once the sibling it calls into is present, and this whole floor is the lane measuring a smaller universe than the code runs in.

Two things moved it since the last stamp. The rebase brought 810793d55 from upstream, which defines _sanitize_message_text and resolved the two calls at invoice_upload_controller.py:118 and :140 -- that was a real defect already fixed upstream while this branch sat 44 commits behind, which is why it read 82 against a floor of 80 and was deliberately left orphaned rather than banked. And 476d5f647 repointed a test that called _domain_category_id, a name the tag rename left defined nowhere in any of the four repositories.

Re-measured in a clean detached worktree of agromarin laid out beside a clean odoo worktree, as the lane lays it out. The stamp names an agromarin commit, so an odoo rebase does not orphan it.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/py_unresolved_calls.py --roots agromarin --count -- and it reads 80, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root agromarin` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

82 -> 80. Set at what the tree read the day the gate learned --roots, then immediately paid down by the two of the 82 that were real. The gate itself already ran over the community fork; SCOPES was hardcoded to odoo/ and addons/, so a call to a method nothing defines was caught in the framework and nowhere else. What motivated the scope: quality_mrp_certificate's action_view_quality_certificates -- a button on the MO form -- called ir.actions.actions._for_xml_id, renamed to _get_action_dict_by_xml_id by 52f7aceeadc, and raised AttributeError on every click; its own module's six tests passed either way. The two paid down here: remote/migrations/19.0.1.2.1/post-migrate.py called remote.device._compute_token_fingerprint and flushed token_fingerprint, a field and a compute 993da3ae7 removed when the digest moved into api_communication -- the script could only raise, and it raises during an upgrade, so any database still below 19.0.1.2.1 could not be upgraded; and stock_blocked_location's _run_scheduler helper kept an else-branch calling stock.rule._run_scheduler_tasks behind `if "stock.scheduler" in self.env`, a guard that is always true in this fork, so the branch was dead. 78 OF THE 80 ARE LANE BLINDNESS, NOT DEBT. This repository's modules depend on enterprise ones, and this lane checks out only agromarin and the community fork, so every call into enterprise reads as unresolved. The true reading is two, and it is one command away wherever enterprise is checked out beside this repository:\n    python odoo/tooling/architecture/py_unresolved_calls.py \\\n        --roots agromarin --also-define enterprise --top 0\nBoth survivors are in l10n_mx_edi_payslip/tests/test_dispersion.py, which calls _generate_bbva_dispersion and _generate_santander_dispersion on hr.payslip.run; the feature now lives in agromarin/hr_bank_dispersion, which resolves a generator from the bank's BIC and implements only _generate_ing_dispersion -- so those two banks are silently skipped. Whether two formats were lost in the split or two test files are stale is a decision this gate cannot make; the research note carries the evidence. Do not allowlist the other 78: they are first-party names in a repository this lane cannot see, and silencing them would hide the next real orphan. Checking enterprise out in this lane is what would make the floor mean something, and that is a credentials question, not a tooling one. Meanwhile the floor is monotonic (--mode no-increase), so a NEW unresolved call still fails whether or not the standing ones can be resolved here.
